children: (TheNewswire)
Calgary, Alberta (September 22, 2026) – TheNewswire - Aurwest Resources Corporation (“Aurwest” or the “Company”)
announces the appointment of Dr. Irvine R. Annesley, Ph.D., P.Geo., as Senior Exploration Advisor to advance the Company’s Canadian uranium assets.

“I am pleased to welcome Dr. Annesley to Aurwest as Senior Exploration Advisor,” commented Cameron MacDonald, Interim President & Chief Executive Officer. “His extensive experience in the uranium industry, both in Canada and internationally, together with his deep knowledge of the Athabasca Basin — including the Wollaston-Mudjatik trend in which our Porter Lake property is located — will directly support our exploration and development work ahead.”

Dr. Annesley (Ph.D., P.Geo.) is current Adjunct Professor (2003-present) in Geological Sciences at the University of Saskatchewan (Saskatoon, Canada) and former Professor (Emeritus: 2022-present) in Economic (Mining and Mineral Exploration) Geology at École Nationale Supérieure de Géologie ("ENSG", Nancy, France).

He has over 40 years of geological mapping, global exploration activities, applied research, and academic teaching experience in uranium, gold, and base metals, including 23 years as Adjunct Professor at the University of Saskatchewan, 6.5 years as Full Professor teaching at the ENSG - Universite de Lorraine, 1.5 years as VP Exploration at Appia REU Corp., 5.5 years as Director of Exploration with JNR Resources Inc. ("JNR"), and 19 years as a senior research geoscientist / manager with the Saskatchewan Research Council ("SRC").

His research has focused mainly on the unconformity-type uranium deposits in the Athabasca Basin (Saskatchewan) and worldwide, as well as global uranium-thorium-REE deposits (e.g. Fraser Lakes, Karpinka Lake, and Alces Lake, Saskatchewan). This research work has helped develop innovative geophysical/geochemical exploration tools for making new economic discoveries. Additionally, Dr. Annesley’s early research at SRC documented and characterized the ductile-brittle framework and spatial association of the eastern Athabasca uranium deposits with major deep-seated reactivated shear/fault zones and coinciding domain boundaries (i.e. the Wollaston-Mudjatik boundary/transition zone, which the Porter Lake property lies close to).  In 2015, Dr. Annesley was co-awarded the Barlow Medal by the Canadian Institute of Mining, Metallurgy and Petroleum ("CIM"); in recognition of best geological paper. Dr. Annesley received his Ph.D. degree in geology at the University of Ottawa (1990) and is a registered professional geologist in Saskatchewan ("APEGS").
Dr. Annesley has been engaged as Senior Exploration Advisor to the Company pursuant to a written advisory services agreement, effective September 22, 2026.
Stock Option Grant

The Board of Directors of the Company has approved the grant of an aggregate of 700,000 stock options (the “Options”) pursuant to the Company’s stock option plan (the “Stock Option Plan”) to certain directors, officers and consultants of the Company, subject to the acceptance of the Canadian Securities Exchange (the “CSE”). Each Option entitles the holder thereof to acquire one common share of the Company at an exercise price of $0.20 per common share for a period of five years from the date of grant. The Options were granted under, and are subject to, the terms and conditions of the Stock Option Plan and are subject to a statutory four-month hold period in accordance with applicable securities laws.
